notes: Theoretical/numerical study of QCD axion dark matter abundance from string defects in the post-inflationary scenario. The paper derives a lower bound on the QCD axion mass, but the abstract/main-text excerpt provided does not contain a numerical exclusion plot or table with extractable (mass, coupling/f_a) data points. The main quantitative result reported here is the ratio Q = n_a^str/n_a^mis vs xi*log(mr/H) (Fig. 3), which is not directly an axion mass bound in usable form. No tabulated mass values were found in the provided content. | Vision: This is a standard axion landscape summary plot with g_aγγ on the y-axis, NOT an f_a vs m_a plane. Coupling type is AxionPhoton. The plot overlays many experiments (CAST, ADMX, HB, SN1987a, projections). No single clean lower exclusion boundary exists; the dominant continuous laboratory/astrophysical upper bound is the CAST/HB line near 8e-11 GeV^-1, traced here. The KSVZ/DFSZ QCD lines run diagonally. The hint suggesting AxionMass is incorrect for this figure. | Calibration: No calibration needed
